parts.script: A: Hey, Mark! Have you thought about what we should do this weekend?  B: I was actually thinking we could go hiking. There are some great trails nearby.  A: That sounds like fun! Which trail did you have in mind?  B: I read about the Blue Mountain Trail. It’s only about an hour away, and the views are supposed to be amazing.  A: Perfect! What time should we leave?  B: How about 7 AM? That way we can avoid the heat and have a full day out.  A: Good idea. I’ll pack some snacks and water.  B: I can bring my camera too! We should get some great photos.  A: Definitely! Do we need to check the weather?  B: Yes, that’s a good point. I’ll check it right now.  A: Awesome! Let’s also make sure to wear comfortable shoes.  B: Agreed! I’ll send you a message with the weather update.  A: Great, thanks! Looking forward to it.

questions.question: What activity do Mark and A plan for the weekend?
questions.explanation: Mark and A plan to go hiking.

questions.explanation: They decide on the Blue Mountain Trail and plan to leave at 7 AM.

questions.explanation: A suggests checking the weather before their trip.

questions.explanation: They want to leave early to avoid the heat.
